definitions.adult: Cheapest adult weekend (main full-festival) ticket on sale, or last on sale, for the 2027 edition. For camping festivals this is the ticket that includes camping. Partial-weekend tickets are listed as extras.
definitions.noncamp: Cheapest adult full-festival ticket without camping.
definitions.per_day: adult price divided by the number of days the ticket covers: the days named in the ticket label where it covers fewer days than the festival, otherwise the calendar days in the published festival dates (computed, not sourced).
definitions.fees: included = price shown includes booking fee; extra = page says fees are added; unknown = page does not say.

source_types.official: Festival's own site or its official ticket page

festivals.status_note: Dates confirmed as Wednesday 7 to Saturday 10 July 2027: every page of 2000trees.co.uk carries '7TH - 10TH JULY 2027', and the ticket types match (3-day Thursday to Saturday, 4-day Wednesday to Saturday). The ticket shop shows the booking window ending on Sunday 11 July at 15:00 because that is the departure deadline (the site says all guests must be off site by 14:00 on Sunday).
